verdict.rationale: Wrike documents a REST API for reading and writing workspace data, plus an asynchronous Batch API, so it can be driven programmatically without the UI, which is the core of headless automation for a SaaS product. The evidence never covers a CLI, CI/CD usage, or non-interactive service-account or token auth; only OAuth 2.0, which is user-delegated, is mentioned. missing for 10: official CLI or CI runner integration, documented non-interactive or service-account authentication for pipelines, CI/headless usage guides, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Call the [API endpoints](/reference) to read and write Wrike data.
